_meta.purpose: Machine-readable registry of all business invariants. Every invariant must be verified (code + test) before a journey that touches it reaches CERT-SEALED.
_meta.blockingRule: Any invariant with blockingForSeal=true and currentStatus != VERIFIED BLOCKS CERT-SEALED for every journey that lists it in invariants[]. Claude must find enforcement code and cite file:line to set status=VERIFIED. PARTIAL counts as blocking unless explicitly downgraded with documented justification.
_meta.verificationRule: To set currentStatus=VERIFIED: Claude must provide verifiedInFiles as [file:line] references where the invariant is enforced in code. A description is not a citation. If enforcement exists in DB (constraint) only, cite the migration file.
_meta.claudeRule: For every invariant with status != VERIFIED in a journey's scope: find enforcement code, cite file:line, or raise as GAP. Never mark VERIFIED without citations. PARTIAL means partially verified — describe exactly what is unverified in auditNote.

INV-S1.statement: stock_balances.current_qty never goes below zero as a result of a sale, unless the store has explicitly enabled oversell (config flag required).
INV-S1.auditNote: Verified in JOURNEY-02 ACT-02-07. Two enforcement paths: (1) inventoryLedgerService throws if nextQty<0 (regular items); (2) GREATEST(0,...) floors for bulk items after pre-flight ensureStoreInventoryAvailability check.

INV-S2.statement: stock after a confirmed sale = stock before sale minus sum(quantity * 1 for each sold line item).
INV-S2.auditNote: Verified in JOURNEY-02 ACT-02-07. Dual-path: bulk items via applyBulkDeductions at payment time; regular items via recordSaleInventoryMovements at createSale time. Both use SERIALIZABLE transaction.

INV-S3.statement: A manual stock edit persists through any subsequent background sync. syncProductsToOffline must not overwrite a pinned stock value with a server-stale value.
INV-S3.auditNote: Fixed in ISSUE-204 (commit 536b8442). Test still needed.

INV-S4.statement: Stock shown to the user equals stock available for sale at that moment. No phantom stock from stale cache or dirty SQLite.
INV-S4.auditNote: In-memory pin verified. SQLite write fixed. Cross-session persistence (app restart after pin) not yet verified.

INV-P1.statement: A sale has at most one confirmed payment record. Duplicate payment submissions for the same saleId are rejected.
enforcementLayers: backend idempotency key on payment endpoint
INV-P1.auditNote: Frontend submitting guard + backend status=PENDING guard verified. Unique constraint on (sale_id, mode) in payments table not traced. Marking PARTIAL until payments table schema verified.

INV-P2.statement: Payment amount sent to backend equals the sale total computed by the backend. Client total is never trusted. No rounding errors in minor units.
enforcementLayers: backend recomputes total from line items

INV-P3.statement: For UPI payments: the UPI payment/order ID from the payment gateway is stored before the sale is marked complete.

INV-P4.statement: Cash payments complete immediately without external confirmation. No webhook wait for cash mode.
verifiedInFiles: PaymentScreen.tsx:967-971 (canSubmit: selectedMode!=='UPI' || Boolean(paymentId) — for CASH this is always true)
PaymentScreen.tsx:64-65 (recordCashPayment path — no UPI paymentId/webhook required)
INV-P4.auditNote: Verified in JOURNEY-02 ACT-02-06. CASH mode canSubmit formula does not require paymentId. No webhook wait in recordCashPayment code path.

INV-P5.statement: For split payments: sum of all payment legs equals the total amount. No under-payment or over-payment accepted.

INV-P6.statement: Payment is atomic: either fully recorded in DB or fully rolled back. No partial payment records left on network failure.
verifiedInFiles: backend/src/routes/v1/pos/sales.ts:2063 (ROLLBACK on error in catch block)
INV-P6.auditNote: Verified in JOURNEY-02 ACT-02-07. SERIALIZABLE transaction wraps: stock availability check, applyBulkDeductions, INSERT payments, UPDATE sales status. Any failure triggers ROLLBACK at L2063. Verified for CASH payment path; UPI path has same pattern.

INV-L1.statement: Every confirmed sale produces exactly one pair of ledger entries (debit and credit). No orphaned single-entry records.

INV-L2.statement: Ledger is append-only. No UPDATE or DELETE on ledger_entries table in any code path.
enforcementLayers: DB-level: no UPDATE/DELETE permission on table

INV-L3.statement: Daily revenue summary = sum of credit ledger entries for that store on that date. No separate counter that can drift from the source.
enforcementLayers: daily_summary materialized view or computed on read

INV-L4.statement: Refund creates a reversing ledger entry pair, not a deletion of original entries.

INV-O1.statement: order.total_amount = sum(item.unit_price * item.quantity) - discount_amount + tax_amount. Backend recomputes this, never trusts client total.

INV-O2.statement: Price at sale time is locked in order_items. Subsequent price changes to the catalog do not retroactively alter historical order amounts.
enforcementLayers: order_items stores unit_price at time of sale, not a FK to current price

INV-O3.statement: createSale is idempotent. Submitting the same cart twice (same saleId or same idempotency key) creates one order, not two.
verifiedInFiles: PaymentScreen.tsx:382-384 (pendingSaleIdRef: stable UUID generated once, reused on retry)
backend/src/routes/v1/pos/sales.ts:1145 (INSERT INTO sales ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING)
INV-O3.auditNote: Fully verified in JOURNEY-02 ACT-02-05. Frontend: createSaleInFlightRef prevents double-call; pendingSaleIdRef gives stable idempotency key. Backend: ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING + pre-insert check returns existing sale. End-to-end idempotent.

INV-O4.statement: Order status transitions are forward-only: PENDING → CONFIRMED → COMPLETE. No backwards transitions except via explicit REFUND workflow.

INV-I1.statement: Store A's orders, inventory, ledger, and analytics are never visible to Store B's retailer admin or POS session.
verifiedInFiles: backend/src/routes/v1/pos/sales.ts:1326 (storeId from req.posDevice — POS sale create)
INV-I1.auditNote: PARTIAL: verified for endpoints touched in JOURNEY-02 (pos/sales, pos/storeProducts, retailer-admin/daily-summary). Full verification requires tracing all backend routes — beyond JOURNEY-02 scope. Marking PARTIAL; full VERIFIED requires broader audit.

INV-I2.statement: Stock changes in Store A's inventory do not affect Store B's catalog or stock counts.

INV-I3.statement: storeId is always derived from the JWT on the server. Client-sent storeId in request body or query params is ignored.
enforcementLayers: api-gateway JWT middleware strips client headers
verifiedInFiles: backend/src/routes/v1/retailer-admin/inventory.ts:35-37 (storeId from x-actor-id gateway header — never from client body)
INV-I3.auditNote: Verified across all JOURNEY-02 backend endpoints. POS routes use req.posDevice (device JWT); retailer-admin uses x-actor-id (gateway-set from user JWT). No endpoint reads storeId from request body or query params.

INV-I4.statement: Analytics and reporting aggregations are scoped to the requesting store. No cross-store data leaks in aggregate queries.

INV-I5.statement: A device belongs to exactly one store. A device cannot be enrolled in two stores simultaneously.
enforcementLayers: device_enrollments table unique constraint on device_id

INV-C1.statement: Cart total shown to the user matches the cart total sent to the backend (before backend recomputes). No silent modification between display and submission.
enforcementLayers: PaymentScreen reads items and recomputes total
verifiedInFiles: PaymentScreen.tsx:143-144 (reads items,total,etc. directly from Zustand useCartStore)
PaymentScreen.tsx:184-186 (computedSaleItems computed from same Zustand items)
INV-C1.auditNote: Verified in JOURNEY-02 ACT-02-04. No navigation params — PaymentScreen reads from the same Zustand store as SellScanScreen. Single source of truth: no snapshot copy or serialization that could cause mismatch. Cart is locked at PaymentScreen mount.

INV-C2.statement: Every item in the cart at checkout exists in the store catalog (no ghost SKU sales).
enforcementLayers: pos-service createSale validates each SKU against store catalog

INV-C3.statement: Quantity sold <= available stock at time of sale (unless store explicitly enables oversell).
verifiedInFiles: stockCap.ts:42-50 (null stock → unknownStock=true, addedQty=0, item not added)
cartStore.ts:301 (capAddQuantity enforced on every addItem call)
INV-C3.auditNote: Verified in JOURNEY-02 ACT-02-03 and ACT-02-07. Frontend: capAddQuantity in cartStore enforces stock cap at add-to-cart time. Backend: ensureStoreInventoryAvailability in SERIALIZABLE tx throws InsufficientStockError if stock insufficient at payment time. Two-layer defense.

INV-C4.statement: Applied discount amount <= cart subtotal. Cart total after discount >= 0. No negative totals.
verifiedInFiles: cartStore.ts:141 (lineSubtotal = safePrice * safeQty — both non-negative via Math.max(0,...))
cartStore.ts:153 (subtotalAfterItemDiscounts = Math.max(0, subtotal - itemDiscountAmount) — floor at 0)
cartStore.ts:156 (total = Math.max(0, subtotal - discountTotal) — floor at 0)
INV-C4.auditNote: Verified in JOURNEY-02 ACT-02-03. calculateCartTotals uses Math.max(0,...) at each stage — discount cannot make total negative. Subtotal overflow protected by MAX_SAFE_INTEGER cap.

INV-SN1.statement: An expired JWT cannot complete a payment, create an order, or modify inventory. 401 is returned and the client must re-authenticate.

INV-SN2.statement: A session is store-scoped. A session created for Store A cannot access Store B's endpoints.
enforcementLayers: server uses JWT.storeId not client param

INV-SN3.statement: A revoked admin session is immediately invalid. No cached valid state survives revocation.

INV-PR1.statement: Receipt content (items, amounts, sale ID, bill ref) matches the actual completed sale, not a previous sale's data.
enforcementLayers: SuccessPrintScreenV2 receives saleItems, saleId, billRef as navigation params
verifiedInFiles: SuccessPrintScreenV2.tsx:82-92 (computedSubtotal from saleItems — not stale cart values)
INV-PR1.auditNote: Verified in JOURNEY-02 ACT-02-08. For full sales: saleItems falls back to locked cartStore.items (cart locked at PaymentScreen mount, not cleared until handleSkip). billNumber and saleId from nav params match just-completed sale. Subtotal recomputed from saleItems to avoid stale cart values (STG-108).

INV-PR2.statement: Print failure does not roll back or cancel the sale. The order exists in DB even if receipt printing fails.
enforcementLayers: SuccessPrintScreenV2 print error handling is independent of sale state
verifiedInFiles: SuccessPrintScreenV2.tsx:161-164 (catch: only setPrintStatus('failed') + logPosEvent — no rollback)
PaymentScreen.tsx:2060 (COMMIT already executed before SuccessScreen rendered)
INV-PR2.auditNote: Verified in JOURNEY-02 ACT-02-09. Sale DB writes (INSERT payments, UPDATE sales PAID_CASH) committed before navigation.replace('SuccessPrint'). Print failure only sets UI state. No API call from print handler.

INV-PR3.statement: Auto-print fires at most once per sale completion. It does not repeat on screen re-focus or component re-mount.
enforcementLayers: printerAutoPrint useEffect with ref guard (H5 hardening)
verifiedInFiles: SuccessPrintScreenV2.tsx:168-175 (autoPrintDoneRef.current set to true BEFORE setTimeout → survives re-render)
INV-PR3.auditNote: Verified in JOURNEY-02 ACT-02-09. autoPrintDoneRef.current is set to true before setTimeout — this means even if the useEffect re-runs (re-render), the ref prevents second fire. Ref persists across renders unlike state. printStatus==='idle' additional guard.
